Title: Login success (standard_user)
Steps: 1) Open https://www.saucedemo.com; 2) Enter username: standard_user; 3) Enter password; 4) Click Login
Expected Result: User redirected to Inventory page; products list visible

Title: Add single item to cart
Steps: 1) On Inventory page click 'Add to cart' for one item; 2) Observe cart badge; 3) Open Cart
Expected Result: Cart badge shows 1; Cart contains selected item

Title: Checkout happy path (1 item)
Steps: 1) Open Cart; 2) Click Checkout; 3) Fill First Name, Last Name, Zip; 4) Continue; 5) Finish
Expected Result: Checkout complete page shown; success message visible
